recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: crude oil breaching a hundred dollars per barrel
overcast dusk settling over the bay
early september fog creeping inland before sunset
autumn's first week — warm days, cooling nights
harvest season beginning across the northern hemisphere

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Steer a lighthouse beam through rolling fog banks — cut through clear patches before the light dims and ships lose sight of shore.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each gap cleared sends a pulse of warm light across the water
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog banks merge and sweep faster as visibility drops

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Seal crude barrels before the pipeline overflows — tap lids shut in rhythm as pressure builds behind each one.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: perfect seal chains burst into amber sparks
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: pipe pressure climbs, barrels arrive faster with less margin
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: industrial amber glow on matte black

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Flick parallel agent tasks into matching lanes before they collide — same chat, different brains, one thumb orchestrating the split.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: aligned agents merge into a satisfying synthesis burst
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: more task types spawn and lanes narrow

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Sort falling autumn leaves into warm and cool bins before they pile up — wind gusts redirect them mid-air.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: perfect streaks fill a saturation bar that blooms across the screen
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: wind gusts scatter leaves off-course and bins shrink
